@[reducible] def Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine : Type :=
Option ℂ
def Conjecture7767.affine : ℂ → Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine :=
fun z => some z
def Conjecture7767.infinity : Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine :=
none
def Conjecture7767.projectiveMap : Polynomial ℂ → Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine → Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine :=
fun p => Option.map fun a => Polynomial.eval a p
def Conjecture7767.Periodic : (Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine → Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine) →
  Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine → Prop :=
fun F P => ∃ r, 0 < r ∧ F^[r] P = P
def Conjecture7767.CommonPeriodicSet : (Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine → Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine) →
  (Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine → Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine) → Set Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine :=
fun F G => {P | Conjecture7767.Periodic F P ∧ Conjecture7767.Periodic G P}
def Conjecture7767.CommonIterate : (Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine → Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine) →
  (Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine → Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine) → Prop :=
fun F G => ∃ m n, 0 < m ∧ 0 < n ∧ F^[m] = G^[n]
def Conjecture7767.powerPolynomial : ℕ → Polynomial ℂ :=
fun d => Polynomial.X ^ d
def Conjecture7767.powerMap : ℕ → Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine → Conjecture7767.ProjectiveLine :=
fun d => Conjecture7767.projectiveMap (Conjecture7767.powerPolynomial d)
def Conjecture7767.root : ℕ → ℂ :=
fun k => Complex.exp (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I / ↑(5 ^ (k + 1)))
def Conjecture7767.LeadingAssertion : Prop :=
∀ (f g : Polynomial ℂ),
  2 ≤ f.natDegree →
    2 ≤ g.natDegree →
      Function.Commute (Conjecture7767.projectiveMap f) (Conjecture7767.projectiveMap g) →
        ((Conjecture7767.CommonPeriodicSet (Conjecture7767.projectiveMap f) (Conjecture7767.projectiveMap g)).Infinite ↔
          Conjecture7767.CommonIterate (Conjecture7767.projectiveMap f) (Conjecture7767.projectiveMap g))

source_declaration_inventory.method: Line-based independent declaration scan after masking comments/strings, tracking namespaces and sections. Simple guillemet-quoted components such as «prefix» normalize to logical names. Anonymous/private or unsupported quoted declarations require explicit review rather than silent omission.

proof_bypass_scan.method: Lexical scan after masking nested block comments, line comments, and string literals; raw matches retained for inspection.

execution_audit_scope: Fresh independent build and trust/identity verification; separate from the independent semantic review.

complete_environment_audit.method: Enumerate imported environment constants by actual originating module; emit full type, declaration kind, safety flags and transitive collectAxioms result for every constant. No name-prefix filter or silent exclusion.
complete_environment_audit.compiler_runtime_note: All runtime constants remain included and axiom-audited; _cstage1/_cstage2 compiler outputs are distinguished from safe kernel-level authored declarations.
